query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM release_states rs
                    JOIN destinations d ON d.id = rs.destination_id
                    WHERE rs.project_id = $1
                      AND d.organisation = $2
                      AND d.name = $3
                      AND rs.completed_at IS NOT NULL
                      AND rs.completed_at < $4
                ) AS "shared!"
